description: I am not required to share my gifts with everyone #selflove #observation #dreamlife
transcript: I preserve myself by being observant and cautious when it comes to sharing my gifts with people, places, or things. It is important for me to live in alignment, and that looks like knowing that just because I can't do something or just because I do something well, not mean that I'm required to use my gifts and my skills in that moment. Sometimes the best thing that we can do to preserve ourselves is observe.
